name: Alan Ni
current_role: Co-Founder and Chief Technology Officer, Grow Therapy
profile: Alan Ni is a Duke-trained computer scientist who held product and engineering roles at Stripe and Google before co-founding Grow Therapy in 2020 with Duke friends Jake Cooper and Manoj Kanagaraj. He leads engineering, product and design at Grow (~$3B valuation), focusing on AI-enabled systems for safety, personalization and continuity of care.
interesting_fact: Grow's platform includes AI-generated pre-visit clinical overviews for providers and a Measurement Informed Care platform; its network spans ~26,000 providers.
deep_cut_fact: Before Grow he was a product manager at Stripe and Google.
notes: Low public profile; route via Grow comms.

name: Ashish Jhina
profile: Ashish Jhina co-founded Jumbotail in 2015 with Stanford MBA classmate Karthik Venkateswaran. Jumbotail is a B2B food-and-grocery marketplace with its own logistics and fintech arms serving India's kirana stores; it became a unicorn after a $120M SC Ventures-led round in 2025 and absorbed Solv India.
interesting_fact: Jumbotail converts traditional mom-and-pop shops into 'J24' modern convenience stores still owned and operated by the original retailers.
notes: No published press email found; press releases issued by 'Jumbotail Corporate Communications'.
